findings: createDefaultAdapters creates one Composio provider: desktop always signed hosted transport; non-desktop explicit environment key selects direct transport; otherwise proxy origin can be configured.
Retired native key ciphertext can remain on disk, but createSettingsStore.environment exposes only the vault key and renderer settings expose preferences only.
No legacy provider route, owner-UUID adoption or migration certificate exists in the selected provider and proxy sources. The old server integration-key module is removed.
Sandbox workspace constructor receives container/workspace-root or tenant computer metadata, not project keys or private signing keys; this is source review, not a launched-container observation.

limitations: Synthetic native encryption adapter exercises the actual settings store; no OS keychain interaction.
No live OAuth, connected account, provider delivery, model or recipient.
No actual sandbox container launch; sandbox constructor configuration checked in source.
Provider-selection and service/database contract evidence; native full-app reconnect UI and live OAuth are separate cases.
cost: No paid provider or model calls; local CPU only.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Composition uses raw string truthiness to choose direct mode. Whitespace-only environment values enter the SDK as explicit nonempty strings, then HTTP Headers normalizes the project-key header to empty.
hypotheses.prediction: Normalize at both Composio composition boundaries before selecting/constructing a provider. Both whitespace holdouts then use hosted signed requests with no project-key header; all original explicit-key and identity variants remain unchanged.
hypotheses.rejectionEvidence: Either whitespace holdout remains direct, or a nonblank explicit key or desktop/tenant selection changes unexpectedly.
